Boi canh: nhanh feature/da-nguoi-dung, da chot xong Lat 3 (nen phan quyen) va Lat 4 (di tru du lieu, PIC sang User) - xem CR-20260913-nen-tang-da-nguoi-dung.md muc 6.2/6.3 hien tai va docs/exchanges/2026-09-19.md cho toan bo qua trinh. Vong nay THIET KE KY THUAT cho LAT 5 (FR 21-22, 31-33, 38, 43-44) - KHONG PHAI code that, khong sua file code.

Luu y quan trong: Bao cao tuan da co ban thiet ke MAN HINH kha chi tiet tu truoc do trong cung ngay (prototype-review.html da xoa, nhung noi dung thiet ke - wizard 4 buoc, cach nhom theo project/nguoi, vi tri khoi Risk, dieu kien cascade voi Project FR-7a) da ghi trong docs/exchanges/2026-09-19.md phan dau. Vong nay TAP TRUNG vao phan CHUA lam: schema/API cho cau hinh loai bao cao theo tung team (FR-22), bang luu Risk co cau truc, hop dong upload file dinh kem Mind Map (FR-43), Redmine tung nguoi + chong SSRF (FR-44), va xac nhan go bo MCP server (FR-38).

Doc that ky: FR-21/21a/22 (bao cao tuan), FR-31/32/32a (task ca nhan, mindmap), FR-38 (go MCP), FR-43 (upload an toan), FR-44 (Redmine SSRF). Doc CODE THAT: server/lib/weekly-report.ts (2 loai bao cao ghi cung hien tai), server/routes/weekly.ts, server/schema/mindmap*.ts hoac tuong duong (bang mindmaps hien co), server/routes/mindmaps.ts, server/mcp.ts (se go bo), cau hinh Redmine hien tai (mot khoa dung chung, o dau trong code/schema).

NHIEM VU:
1) Schema cho FR-22: bang cau hinh loai bao cao theo team (thay 2 gia tri ghi cung internal/vn_management), co thuoc tinh requiresProjectRisk da chot 19/09; bang luu Risk co cau truc (team, tuan, loai bao cao, project, risk, bien phap) thay vi nhung trong text.
2) FR-43: schema mindmap_attachments (da liet trong CR 6.3) - chi tiet cot, quy tac xac thuc tai file (khong chi kiem path traversal ma phai tra quyen so huu/chia se), danh sach dinh dang cho phep chinh xac (FR-32a da chot: anh + pdf/txt/md/csv/html + docx/xlsx/pptx), kiem ca duoi ten LAN magic bytes.
3) FR-44: thiet ke bang user_redmine_config (moi nguoi 1 khoa, ma hoa), va co che chong SSRF cho URL Redmine he thong (chi HTTPS, khong credentials/fragment trong URL, chan IP noi bo/loopback/link-local khi resolve DNS).
4) FR-38: xac nhan chinh xac nhung gi can xoa (server/mcp.ts, cau hinh lien quan, script khoi dong) va kiem tra khong con duong ghi nao khac bo qua xac thuc.
5) Neu phat hien mau thuan/lo hong giua CR va code that thi neu ro, de xuat sua, KHONG tu y sua CR trong vong nay.

YEU CAU DAU RA: ban thiet ke ky thuat hoi tu (khong PASS/FAIL): (1) schema cau hinh loai bao cao + Risk co cau truc, (2) schema+quy tac mindmap_attachments, (3) schema+SSRF cho Redmine tung nguoi, (4) danh sach can xoa cho FR-38, (5) danh sach cho con mau thuan/can Leader quyet dinh (neu co).
